findings.problem: The full passive "La comida fue hecha por mi madre" sounds stiff for food in everyday speech, where people would say "La comida la hizo mi mamá"; a written work is a more natural place for the por agent.
findings.fix: example.es: Esta canción fue escrita por mi hermano. / example.en: This song was written by my brother.

back.es: by (agent of a passive or participle), also for, through, because of
back.example: The food was made by my mother.

note: The prompt clearly separates this card from the cause/exchange and through cards, because \"escrito\" makes por the only natural answer and rules out de.
